The TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO gate captures edge by vetoing call entries when a bearish structure is confirmed, thus avoiding wrong-way trades.

The gate checks for a bearish structure confirmation after a trendline break. If confirmed, it vetoes call entries.
